# Angular Lab

> Angular Lab is a hands-on playground for learning Angular by building. It has 15+ interactive lessons with animated diagrams and a demo app, built by Youssef Ezzat.

## Lessons

- [Binding](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/binding): data binding basics
- [Pipes](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/pipes): built-in and custom pipes
- [Directives](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/directives): structural and attribute directives
- [Component communication](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/communication): inputs, outputs and services
- [Forms](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/forms): template-driven and reactive forms
- [Routing](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/routing): routes, params and navigation
- [Guards](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/guards): route guards
- [Signals](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/signals): signal-based reactivity
- [RxJS](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/rxjs): observables and operators
- [Dependency injection](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/di): providers and injectors
- [Interceptors](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/interceptor): HTTP interceptors
- [Facade pattern](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/facade): state facades
- [Change detection](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/change-detection): how Angular updates the view
- [Lazy loading](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/lazy-loading): lazy routes
- [Content projection](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/content-projection): ng-content
- [Resource](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/resource): the resource API
- [Defer](https://angular-lab-omega.vercel.app/learn/defer): @defer blocks

## Optional
